note: Corrections to the league Obvibase register, applied by scripts/build_trade_counts.py at read time. The register is John's and is re-exported from time to time; hand-editing a derived file would be undone by the next export and would leave no record of who changed what. Each entry names the register row by its own id, says what is wrong with it, and cites who said so. `drop` removes the row from every count and every price; `set` rewrites fields. A row whose id is absent from a future export is reported, not silently skipped.

corrections.why: The row has one side. It records The Machines sending Travis Kelce, a 2027 second and Ben Sinnott, with nothing entered coming back, on the league's draft day -- nine entries deep, the busiest page in the register and the likeliest place for a row to be opened and never finished. John offered a reading of it (Big Blue sending TJ Hockenson) and then could not confirm it. An unconfirmed trade is not a trade this desk will count, price or publish, so the row is dropped from everything. It is recorded here, in full, so it can be restored the moment somebody can say for certain what came back and from whom.
corrections.source: John, league commissioner, 21 October 2026: 'Leave out the trade with hockenson that we've been questioning. I can't confirm it all.'
corrections.effect: The Machines read 13 deals in 2025 rather than 14, and the register agrees with the itemised ledger on all sixteen franchises in all five seasons.
